WhoAreWeText: Aquazzurra Restaurant is located in the Aquazzurra resort in Cannobio, on Lake Maggiore. The restaurant is open to everyone, not just resort guests, and offers a wide selection of Italian dishes prepared with fresh and high-quality ingredients. The restaurant is open every day for both lunch and dinner.
